project_summary: Requirements focus on establishing and executing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) automated testing pipelines to ensure code quality and seamless deployment processes.
identified_risks: Vague requirement input lacks specifics on testing frameworks and target environments.
Risk of pipeline failures causing deployment bottlenecks if test suites are flaky or unoptimized.

user_stories.title: Automate Test Execution in CI/CD Pipeline
user_stories.user_story: As a DevOps engineer, I want to configure the CI/CD pipeline to automatically run automated test suites on code commits, so that regression issues are identified early in the development cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code pull request is submitted, When the CI/CD pipeline triggers, Then all unit and integration tests execute automatically.
Given the automated test run completes, When tests pass, Then the pipeline proceeds to the build phase.
Given the automated test run completes, When any test fails, Then the pipeline halts and notifies the developer.
